Unlucky Cabbage Merchant.notes: "Put this creature on the bottom of its owner's library" = back to hand, then from hand to the bottom (only if it was still on the battlefield), then the library is shuffled.

When this creature enters, create a Food token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.")
